title.narrative: LINKS - Mobilising Indigenous and Local Knowledge for Sustainable Development

description.narrative: This element supports Indigenous and local knowledge, strengthening capacities, awareness, advocacy and protection through collaboration across knowledge systems (including sciences, culture and languages) and facilitating dialogue between local and Indigenous knowledge-holders, policymakers and experts. The intersectoral initiative is aligned to the framework of the International Decade of Indigenous Languages (2022-2032), the International Decade of Sciences for Sustainable Development, and contributes to sustainable management of natural resources through various frameworks and policies such as the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework and the National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plans (NBSAPs).
